prompt:
Create one clean transparent animation keyframe of this cheerful fantasy raccoon game mascot, Doguri. Same exact character, painted 2D sprite material and E-facing RIGHT side camera as both references. Keep pink round head, burgundy mask, white eye ring, apple with green leaf pointing upper right, very small round torso, stubby pink limbs, burgundy paws, striped purple-grey/white tail with green tip at LEFT. Full mascot including apple, tail and both paws visible with generous empty margin on 1536 by 1024 transparent canvas. No glow, haze, shadow, floor, text or labels. Alpha is zero outside the character. Preserve the original squat cartoon proportions, no long legs or new 3D design.
This is the SECOND airborne running keyframe, with the OPPOSITE limb positions from reference2. Use reference1's near-leg-forward structure: the LARGE FOREGROUND thigh and knee swing FORWARD RIGHT, continue to the LARGE NEAR PAW lifted RIGHT ahead of its torso. The SMALLER BACKGROUND leg angles BACK LEFT, with bent knee and smaller paw trailing LEFT under the tail. Both short attached leg chains remain visible, with the large foreground thigh overlapping in front of the smaller leg at the hip. The large visible arm reaches BACK LEFT beside the torso and tail base, like reference1, while the smaller arm reaches forward right. Do not copy the forward foreground arm or rear foreground leg of reference2.
Both paws are airborne. Put both soles around y=850 or higher, leaving clear air above the imaginary floor at y=950. Do not draw the floor. Head and apple maintain the reference size and light from overhead left; leg joints and arms change naturally without simply shifting or bouncing a still image. This pose prepares the large foreground foot to land next. One complete separate sprite.
